newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Friday said India was taking advantage of the flaws of Ganges water sharing treaty including the absence of any gurantee clause.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria said on Friday he would sue some newspapers for publishing "false and defamatory" reports against him and his daughter-in-law.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Friday called upon the local and foreign investors to set up gas-based industries by taking the advantage of availability of natural gas in Bangladesh.
Japan will provide Bangladesh 15.3 billion Yen ($130 million) as loan assistance during the current year.
Donors are expected to fix strategy for future lending for Bangladesh's energy sector at a four-day meeting beginning on Monday.
Former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad on Friday urged the government not to consider shifting of weekly holiday from Friday to Sunday.
Banks are giving a cold shoulder to rehabilitate the problem-ridden leather industries.

Finance Minister S A M S Kibria on Friday welcomed the remobal of former chairman of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) Imtiyaz Husain, saying that a change had been required for the interest of the capital market.
